reopened_reason: EW-RS-067 finds a common structurally generated motif functional through which the OOO dependency scalar image factors while preserving the sealed formula holdout.

new_assertions.body: The information required for the state/component quotient and the information required for the highest-degree scalar functional are distinct. Exact ROLE_CAPPAR retains mask grouping and role incidence in component identity, while the tested OOO scalar functional can forget those details after the matched dependency quotient is formed.

The coarsest common EW-RS-067 motif rung is width + exact role-capacity-parity mask + owner-separated exact relative-depth histograms. Its unordered triple-motif parity has zero scalar contradictions on all three hard carriers.

On 4x5-k4 the selected motif map has structural image rank 288 versus OOO residue rank 294 while retaining scalar image dimension two, so at least six OOO structural directions are value-null under this motif-level scalar query.

Owner-mask-size profiles alone nearly close the common motif law but leave one 4x5-k4 contradiction; exact owner-separated depth histograms repair that final observed gap without restoring mask grouping or cell-to-role incidence.

A passing motif one-hot parity family is not yet the desired closed syndrome law. The next reduction must operate outcome-independently on the selected motif-parity matrix before any scalar coefficients or individual motif terms are chosen.
EW-RS-059 remains sealed because no closed coefficient/rule realization of the scalar syndromes has been frozen.
